label: FastAPI service
description: A Python web API on FastAPI, with pytest and a README.
task: Scaffold a Python FastAPI service in this empty folder. Create pyproject.toml (Python 3.11 or later) with the dependencies fastapi and uvicorn[standard] and the dev dependencies pytest and httpx; app/__init__.py and app/main.py with a FastAPI app that has GET /health answering {"ok": true} and one small example resource; tests/test_main.py using FastAPI's TestClient. Add a .gitignore for .venv, __pycache__ and .pytest_cache, and a README.md that says what the service is and how to create a virtual environment, install, run it (uvicorn app.main:app --reload) and test it (pytest).
